sentences.text: Hugo mira en el reloj cómo sube el latido de su corazón en la cinta.

sentences.en: Hugo warmed up well to avoid any complications with his back.

sentences.ko: 모임에서 너무 웃어서 파울라는 턱이 아팠어요.

sentences.en: In the gym hangs a poster of an athlete in all his greatness that motivates Hugo.
sentences.ko: 헬스장에는 우고에게 의욕을 주는, 위풍당당한 선수 포스터가 걸려 있어요.

sentences.text: Paula habló con admiración de la grandeza de su antigua profesora.
sentences.en: Paula spoke admiringly of her former teacher's greatness.
sentences.ko: 파울라는 옛 선생님의 훌륭함을 감탄하며 이야기했어요.

sentences.text: Hugo se acercó a estrechar la mano del campeón que visitó el gimnasio.
sentences.en: Hugo went over to shake hands with the champion who visited the gym.
sentences.ko: 우고는 헬스장을 찾은 챔피언에게 다가가 악수했어요.

sentences.text: La reunión sirvió para estrechar la amistad entre Paula y sus compañeros.
sentences.en: The reunion helped strengthen the friendship between Paula and her classmates.
sentences.ko: 그 모임 덕분에 파울라와 동창들의 우정이 더 깊어졌어요.

sentences.text: Hugo piensa que entrenar sin calentar es algo irresponsable.
sentences.en: Hugo thinks training without warming up is irresponsible.
sentences.ko: 우고는 준비 운동 없이 운동하는 건 무책임하다고 생각해요.

sentences.text: Paula admitió que de joven era un poco irresponsable con el dinero.
sentences.en: Paula admitted that when she was young she was a bit irresponsible with money.
sentences.ko: 파울라는 젊었을 때 돈 문제에 좀 무책임했다고 인정했어요.
